item.title: JavaScript BigInt Implementation: Native Support vs External Libraries
item.description:
“JavaScript BigInt Implementation: Native Support vs External Libraries”

How can developers effectively work with integer values exceeding JavaScript’s standard Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER? When dealing with calculations requiring arbitrary precision, what are the recommended approaches, especially considering modern browser capabilities versus the need for robust third-party libraries?

The Evolution of Large Integer Handling in JavaScript

Historically, working with very large integers in JavaScript posed significant precision challenges, often leading developers to rely on external libraries for accurate arithmetic.
